founders.name: Kristen Kita
founders.bio: Founder at Caladh (YC F26). MIT PhD engineer and DARPA Principal Investigator with 10+ years in maritime autonomy spanning UUV navigation, real-time path and behavior planning, multi-agent coordination, and active/passive acoustics. Track record of building and leading maritime autonomy teams from scratch and taking systems from concept through open-ocean demonstration.

Founded a content agency that scaled faceless creators to billions of views across 10 languages using custom Premiere Pro automation. Studying Aerospace/Information Engineering at Cambridge.

founders.name: Doruk Tan Ozturk
founders.bio: Co-founder & CEO at 0.security, previously cyber defense engineer at the largest Swiss conglomerate retailer. Doruk was a Swiss finalist at the math & logic games championship at the age of 14, and won the Swiss startup 2026 award. In 2009, he accidentally installed a virus on the computer of his father while trying to download Minecraft. He's been interested in computers and security ever since.

founders.bio: Co-founder @ 0.security Previously built in Fintech: - Mellivora Capital, a regulated quant fund for institutional investors. - Crypto Finance (sold to Deutsche Börse): early hire + youngest employee, helped scale from 10 to 100+ employees. - BEEYOND Clothing: Founded one of Switzerland's most popular sustainable brands. - 3x Winner Swiss Startup Challenge & Fashion Award from University of St. Gallen (HSG). - Self-taught filmmaker & cinematographer - 4x Olympic Trampoline Swiss Champion.

founders.name: Jonathan Powers
founders.bio: Founder/CEO at Super Powers Mobility (YC F26). Previously Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at Tesla, leading Cybertruck architecture integration including drive units, structures, exterior surfaces, occupant seating, low and high voltage distribution routing, and safety systems. Earlier lead brake system on electric vehicle development at Workhorse and powersports design at Honda R&D. MS & BS in Mechanical Engineering, MBA from Pitt. Also was a pro off-road racer during college.

founders.name: Parker Jamieson
founders.bio: Founder & CEO at Keres (YC F26). Previously served 11 years as a USAF pilot, including F-16 and U-28A Evaluator Pilot roles. Led cadet training operations at HQ AFROTC. Currently IMA to NORAD J3 in the Air Force Reserve. Educated at the U.S. Air Force Academy and École de l'air et de l'espace.

founders.name: Christopher Palazzolo
founders.bio: Co-founder/CTO at Keres (YC F26). Previously Head of Operations at H3X Technologies. Spent 4+ years at Boom Supersonic, rising from Aircraft Technician to Director of Aircraft and Production Operations for the XB-1 supersonic demonstrator. Led avionics, flight test, and manufacturing. BS in Mechanical Engineering from Oakland University.
